text: Repeated-game cooperation results require persistent identity, patient agents, observable deviations, and enforceable punishments, none of which RLRF presently establishes.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reinforcement Learning from Reputation Feedback (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7456999
abstract: Repeated-game results (Fudenberg and Maskin 1986) may become relevant if persistent identity, sufﬁciently patient agents, observable deviations, and enforceable punishments are independently established. RLRF presently establishes none of those conditions. Non-transferability alone is not sufﬁcient for Sybil resistance.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: application of repeated-game results to RLRF
